verdict.rationale: Zamzar offers a public REST API with sandbox and production endpoints, so this story applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning, version identifiers or a deprecation policy. The documented endpoints (sandbox.zamzar.com, api.zamzar.com) carry no version scheme, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
